meaning.en: Any of several celestial objects emitting periodic, short, intense bursts of radio, x-ray, or visible electromagnetic radiation, generally believed to be quickly rotating neutron stars.

meaning.en: A rotating neutron star that emits electromagnetic radiation, esp. radio waves, at short and very regular intervals.
